title: TWC Day 4 leaderboard plan: Semifinal 1 (FURIA vs Aurora) is the sole defensible contrarian slot; Semifinal 2 (Falcons vs BETBOOM) is a Lock
detail: Across both independent external providers (Polymarket CLOB order books and Kalshi KXCS2GAME yes books), Semifinal 1 (FURIA 52.4% / Aurora 47.6%) clears the 30% underdog floor with an expected give-up of 0.048 points per base point, while Semifinal 2 (Falcons 79.3% / BETBOOM 20.7%) places BETBOOM below the 30% floor (fading Falcons costs 0.587 expected points per base point). Under the tournament BO3 scoring rule (7 points team + 5 points score), the uncalibrated BO3 score model recommends FURIA 2-0 (26.6%, EV 5.0 pts) for chalk or Aurora 2-1 (24.2%, EV 4.5 pts) for the contrarian slip in Semifinal 1, and Falcons 2-0 (50.1%, EV 8.1 pts) in Semifinal 2.

title: Aurora's July 2026 rebuild (kyxsan, Jimpphat, coach ash) is already priced; Day 2 and Day 3 sweeps confirm no second roster discount
detail: Aurora's documented roster rebuild occurred on 8 July 2026 (+kyxsan, +Jimpphat, +coach ash; -MAJ3R, -soulfly, -coach Fabre), three months before TWC 2026 in Malta. After dropping the Day 1 opener 0-2 to 9z (Mirage 10-13, Dust2 11-13), the same five-man lineup swept Ninjas in Pyjamas 2-0 (13-6, 13-6) on Day 2 and swept the Day 3 rematch against 9z 2-0 (Cache 13-11, Inferno 13-4). No October roster, stand-in, illness, travel or rest adjustment is established by official sources or applied to any probability.

title: Unresolved low-tier fixtures remain blank with documented source-by-source limitations — never filled with 50/50 or crowd votes
detail: All eight fixtures that lacked a compliant money line or unique five-player Valve rating at the 2026-10-16T19:38:00Z snapshot (1079170, 1081515, 1081526, 1081527, 1081521, 1081522, 1081861, 1081863) were audited across HLTV, Polymarket CLOB, Kalshi KXCS2GAME, Thunderpick, Bovada and Valve's 2026-10-05 regional standings.
